hypothesis: The derived sparse backend achieves at least1.5x warm inference throughput with exact state, stop, and returned-board parity versus GeneralSearch.
method: Canonical repulsive only. Use released sparse kernel NOBIAS=False,hscale=1,unique zero padding; retain GeneralSearch refresh. No integer one-level transform.
gate: 18models k10/17/21,seeds0to5;256devpuzzles [4608,4864); initial plus64checks; all25statefields and capturedboards exactly equal. This bounded measured gate passed before timing, not a universal proof.
order: Alternate general-first and sparse-first for6pairedrepeats on same exclusiveGPU.
primary_statistic: Geometricmean across9cells of median general inference_s divided by median sparse inference_s, excluding warmup.
uncertainty: 5000bootstrap samples of9cells and6pairedrepeats, seed20261114; timing variability only.
decision: Supported if95percentinterval lower>=1.5; falsified ifupper<1.5; otherwise inconclusive. Any state/board/stop mismatch fails exact-parity hypothesis.
timing: Wall setup, production inference, and complete constructor+inference recorded separately with synchronization; CUDAevent sum of _moves calls includes device prep and kernel. Data/model load and precomputed S excluded. Capture, refresh, compaction included.

full_test_followup.selection: Fully fixed before any cohort results; no test tuning. Cohort is held-out from these research development experiments, not asserted externally pristine.
